charge_port.notes: electrive names the "Free2move Charge NACS-CCS1 DC Adapter" for the Wagoneer S, which implies a CCS1 inlet; InsideEVs (review) says the car has no NACS plug but does not name the port standard.

supercharger_access.notes: Stellantis (March 2026): Wagoneer S 2024-2025 can use Tesla Superchargers with the Free2move Charge NACS-CCS1 adapter. Reports say "North America"; Canada implied, not separately confirmed. Canada: the reports say "North America"; no source confirms Canadian cars are covered.
